sections.title: Introduction
sections.content: Practice Linux awk Command: Text Processing. Use the prepared private Linux environment. Explanations and checks here are locally authored from the linked public requirements.
sections.content_vi: Thực hành Lệnh awk: xử lý văn bản. Dùng terminal Linux riêng của bài. Hướng dẫn và bộ kiểm tra local được biên soạn lại theo yêu cầu công khai đã liên kết.

sections.title: Examining the Log File
sections.content:
Inspect field positions in the log.

```bash
head server_logs.txt
```
sections.content_vi:
Xem vị trí các trường trong log.

```bash

```

sections.title: Basic AWK Usage - Printing Specific Fields
sections.content:
Print client addresses and requested resources.

```bash
awk '{print $3, $5}' server_logs.txt | head -n 5
```
sections.content_vi:
In địa chỉ máy khách và tài nguyên yêu cầu.

```bash
awk '{print $3, $5}' server_logs.txt | head -n 5
```

sections.title: Filtering Log Entries
sections.content:
Print POST requests returning an error.

```bash
awk '$4 == "POST" && $6 >= 400 {print $0}' server_logs.txt
```
sections.content_vi:
In yêu cầu POST trả về lỗi.

```bash
awk '$4 == "POST" && $6 >= 400 {print $0}' server_logs.txt
```

sections.title: Counting and Summarizing Data
sections.content:
Count responses by status code.

```bash
awk '{count[$6]++} END {for (code in count) print code, count[code]}' server_logs.txt | sort -n
```
sections.content_vi:
Đếm phản hồi theo mã trạng thái.

```bash
awk '{count[$6]++} END {for (code in count) print code, count[code]}' server_logs.txt | sort -n
```

checks.command:
set -e
cd /home/labex/project/
test -s log_report.awk
grep -qi '<html' log_report.html
grep -q 'Total requests: 4' log_report.html
grep -q 'Error rate: 50%' log_report.html
grep -q 'Top 5 IP Addresses' log_report.html
grep -q '10.0.0.1: 2 requests' log_report.html
grep -q 'Top 5 Requested Resources' log_report.html
cmp -s log_report.html <(awk -f log_report.awk server_logs.txt)
